checks: teaching binds the current active M02 record and requires its exact archived B2 question as the early question
the refined research question states why the selected material needs it, what relation it should explain and how it descends from the M02 question
M11 does not require M10, so B2 research can proceed before, after or interleaved with B1 rather than only as a final polish
current M09, current W16 revision and the exact dossier snapshot are required
actual paragraphs are required for case context, necessary basis, process, boundary/counterexample, knowledge summary and transfer
paragraph order moves from the concrete case through basis and process to boundary, knowledge and transfer
at least two ordered process steps must connect conditions, actions, evidence and results; every PROCESS paragraph must participate, and process-step Evidence cannot exceed that paragraph's Evidence
example/calculation paragraphs require one matching demonstration with assumptions, steps, result and limits; calculations also require values/units and hypothetical values require an explicit label
transfer records shared relations, changed conditions, facts to recheck and what must not be assumed
a professional term must have a plain-language basis/process explanation before the named summary
Concept cards cannot replace the required teaching paragraphs; a necessary recap needs an actual RECAP paragraph
Claim, Evidence and W25 assessment versions must be current exact research-revision inputs
W25 assessments cover exactly the taught Claims and their Evidence union equals the taught Evidence set; irrelevant or background-only records cannot ground B2
the proposition identifies one of the eight canonical knowledge types and states conditions, scope, unknowns and falsifiers
mechanical/empirical mechanism or pattern teaching requires MethodUse that is current in the dossier; Concept links must be current archived Concept versions in the exact revision
bounded teaching needs a supported Claim; partial/limitation teaching carries explicit limits and submits M11 as LIMITED
B1 is optional and can be omitted when B2 has an independently grounded knowledge question and sources
a supplied B1 source requires both the exact current active M10 and its exact AdvisorOutput version
the B1 output must share the dossier, revision, theme and specification
B2 knowledge gain cannot merely relabel the selected B1 case-specific or journal contribution
manual outputs cannot carry model admission, configuration, operation or domain identity
model output requires a current W19 TEACHER/given-material admission and an actual M11 MODEL OperationRequest containing every teaching input
the MODEL operation requires MODEL_PROCESS and a successful receipt recorded before the TeacherOutput; the output references the operation
BOUNDED_EXPLANATION submits READY_FOR_NEXT while partial/limitation teaching submits LIMITED
the output is fixed to role=B2 with facts_verified=false, causal_support=false, reader_mastery_measured=false, content_review_required=true and publication_authorized=false
a TeacherOutput appended before M11 failure is an unadopted deterministic attempt, not a workflow pass
exact retry on the same dossier basis reuses the output and completes M11; a changed basis requires a new TeacherOutput version
completed repeated requests return the current admissible M11 result
concurrent exact writers leave one active M11 and do not overwrite newer snapshots
upstream rework invalidates M11; rebuilding uses the prior M11 record as parent and a new TeacherOutput parent version
